title: SIM binding for WhatsApp explained: the 31 December deadline and what changes for you
seoTitle: SIM binding WhatsApp: what it is and the Dec 31 deadline
seoDescription: SIM binding means WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal work only while the registered SIM is in your phone. Apps must comply by 31 Dec 2026. What changes for you.
excerpt: The current deadline, why the six-hour WhatsApp Web logout was dropped, what happens for NRIs, iPad, dual-SIM and laptop users, and the steps to take before the rule kicks in.
